name: career-portal
description: AI-Powered Student Career & Placement Success Portal — enterprise monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n web,api,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "cd apps/ai-service && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --port 8000"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
